display_long_description:
Christmas is coming and Santa needs a new toymaker! Step into a snowy gingerbread village and make toys the magical way.

BUILD REAL TOYS
Four workbenches, four toys: a car, a train, a robot and a teddy bear. Grab a part from its tray, hold it near the glowing shape and it snaps into place.

PAINT THEM ANY COLOUR
Dip a brush in a paint pot and paint every piece red, green, blue, yellow, purple or white.

WRAP AND DELIVER
Drop your toy in the gift box and it becomes a wrapped present. Carry it out to Santa's sleigh and drop it in his sack. Match an order on Santa's Nice List for 3 stars, and watch Santa dance as fireworks fill the sky.

A WHOLE CHRISTMAS VILLAGE
Cookies and cocoa by the crackling fire in Santa's house, a giant tree to dress with baubles, and a snowball alley full of snowmen in top hats.

NEVER LOST
Picture guides, pop-up hints and a menu that takes you straight to the workshop, the sleigh, the tree or the snowballs. Rank up from Apprentice Elf to Head Elf - your progress is saved.

Christmas carols, falling snow, and no timers or fail states - just the joy of making toys.
